Notes work fully — display, search, edit, and save. Refresh **http://maker:4001**.

**Flow 9 — notes.**
1. A couple of bookmarks now show a **note** — your own text in a highlighted panel below the tags (e.g. the Kyoto one says *"Autumn trip — check the temple opening hours…"*).
2. In the search box, type **`temple`** — a word that appears only in a note. The Kyoto bookmark matches and the word is **highlighted right in the note**, confirming notes are fully searchable alongside title, description, address and tags.
3. **Edit** any bookmark — there's now a **Notes** field to write or change your note. You can also add a note while **saving** a new link.

One decision to confirm:
- The note is shown **in full on the bookmark** (not hidden behind a click), so your own reminder is visible at a glance. Is always-visible the right call, or would you prefer notes tucked away until you open the bookmark?

That's the last planned piece of organising. Once you confirm notes, I'll have covered saving, finding, and organising — and we can look at a few edge situations before moving toward building the real thing.
